basic_info.description: Perched atop Nob Hill in San Francisco's iconic Art Deco landmark, this 1,250 sq. ft. corner home blends timeless elegance with thoughtful modern upgrades. A reimagined floor plan with two full baths rare in the building and windows on three sides fills the interiors with light and sweeping views toward Pacific Heights, the Presidio, and the San Francisco skyline. The entry foyer, illuminated by Murano glass lighting, opens to gracious living and dining spaces with crown molding, hardwood floors, and classic craftsmanship. The chef's kitchen features natural stone counters, mill-grade cabinetry, pantry storage, and premium Bosch appliances with dual sinks. The primary suite enjoys a corner orientation, peek Bay views, generous storage, and an artisan-tiled en-suite bath with a multi-fixture tub and shower. A second full bath stuns with mosaic detail, while in-unit laundry enhances convenience. Building amenities include 24/7 door person service, private storage, a residents-only patio, and a large parking space that fits 1+ cars.
